offers_products.reason: Sells insurance coverage and claims services, not goods; auto and home warranty are insurance-like contracts.

offers_services.reason: Specialty insurance, surety, title insurance, and risk and claims services are core offerings.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Title insurance for home buyers, plus home and auto warranty, reach individuals; this is a smaller part of the business.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Main buyers are contractors, manufacturers, healthcare providers, transportation firms, law firms and public entities buying commercial coverage.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue is renewing commercial insurance premiums, such as workers' compensation, liability and auto, from repeat policyholders.

cyclical_demand.reason: Commercial insurance, workers' compensation and surety are largely mandatory or contract-required; title insurance is a smaller, rate-sensitive part.

big_ticket.reason: Annual insurance premiums are recurring and routine, not large one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for risk-bearing and balance-sheet capacity from insurance policies, not mainly for staff time.

large_customers.reason: Serves a mix of mid-sized and large commercial clients and public entities, with no clear large-enterprise focus.

asset_heavy.reason: Insurer needs capital and an investment portfolio, not plants, fleets or networks, to grow.

notes: Largest part is commercial specialty insurance; title insurance is a sizable second segment. Customer size mix is uncertain.
